topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Damn package, turned up on my doorstep like it had all the right to be here, when it didn't. Should've known better the second I saw the guy's name scrawled on the label – a name I'd never heard, let alone invited into my life. Poked around the contents, just to be sure. Lost property ain't my favorite thing to deal with, especially when it smells like someone else's problems wrapped up neat. Not my job to untangle their mess. Figured I'd make a call, maybe track down whoever this was. You don't expect a stranger's life to show up at your door, not in this city. Least I owed to the sender, and myself, to not let this slide.
